# Pratik Dev

> Software Engineer with 5+ years shipping production web applications end to end — React/Next.js frontends through Node.js/TypeScript/Go backends, plus AI features, third-party API integrations, and backend services, with ownership from UI to production infrastructure. Most recently a Software Engineer at Devspace (Mar 2026 – Aug 2026), building full-stack features on top of an agentic AI pipeline. Portfolio: https://iam-pratik.pages.dev

## Summary

Comfortable owning features across the entire stack: database schema design, REST API development, third-party service integration, AI/LLM features, and rendering strategy on the frontend. Started on the frontend (React/Next.js/Tailwind) and has spent the last stretch of his career going deeper on the backend — Go, distributed systems, databases — driven by wanting to know how things work underneath, not just that they work. Has led small teams, run code reviews, mentored junior developers, and driven architectural decisions on both client and product work. B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering, BGC Trust University, Chattogram, Bangladesh.

## How he works (philosophy)

A system isn't done when it works — it's done when it survives real traffic, bad input, and 3AM failures. That shows up as a preference for boring, correct infrastructure over clever fragility: atomic release gates instead of hoping a deploy lands cleanly, `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` instead of pulling in a broker, backoff written directly into SQL instead of a fragile heartbeat. Off the clock: travel and astronomy.

## Experience

Reverse-chronological. Dates are month/year.

- **Devspace** (https://www.devspace.so/) — Software Engineer, Mar 2026 – Aug 2026. Built full-stack features in React/TypeScript on top of an agentic AI pipeline (Mastra AI, Convex, Vercel AI SDK). Built a dynamic tool registry so agent tools are stored in the database and discovered at runtime instead of hardcoded — only the relevant tools are fetched from the DB for a given request, using vector search. Integrated Codex into the daily development workflow. Contributed to CI/CD pipeline configuration and deployment automation. Tech: React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, Convex, Vercel AI SDK, GitHub Actions, Codex.
- **Osilion** (https://osilion.no/) — Full-Stack Engineer, Jul 2025 – Feb 2026. One of the primary engineers on a client's internal employee productivity tool; mentored a junior developer with regular code reviews; contributed to database design, technical architecture, and component design patterns on an intelligent recruitment platform; built SSR/ISR/SSG features with SEO metadata and Open Graph tags; worked with the Appfarm low-code platform. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, MySQL, C#, Azure, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Zustand, Appfarm (low-code).
- **Hone** (https://hone.gg/) — Frontend Engineer, Aug 2025 – Sep 2025. Worked on Hone's Electron desktop app. Implemented a Smart Scaling system that automatically adapts the desktop app to smaller screens; owned the review and download pages end to end; fixed a responsive layout bug with a CSS grid auto-fit pattern; fixed a keyboard focus-visibility issue; improved code splitting and lazy loading to cut initial load weight. Tech: React, TypeScript, Electron, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Claude Code.
- **Hello World Communications** (https://software.helloworldbd.com/) — Full-Stack Engineer, Sep 2024 – Jul 2025. Led development end to end across multiple concurrent client projects, ran code reviews, made key architectural calls, and mentored a junior developer across multiple client projects; cut client closing time roughly 50% through better scoping; built backend APIs and integrated third-party services (WebSocket real-time features); delivered SSR pages for real-time data and ISR/SSG for marketing surfaces; SEO optimization including structured metadata, sitemaps, and Lighthouse tuning. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Appwrite, Firebase, Docker, Zustand, TanStack Query, shadcn/ui.
- **Bilsida** — Full-Stack Engineer, Oct 2023 – Aug 2024. Built a Swedish car marketplace from scratch across the full stack, which went on to attract two of Sweden's largest car dealers; mentored a junior developer in building a chat system; owned backend logic, database schema design, image optimization, and SEO. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Appwrite, Docker, Context API.
- **Fiverr** (https://www.fiverr.com/pratik_dev) — Freelance Full-Stack Developer, Jul 2021 – Oct 2023. Delivered full-stack web applications and APIs for 20+ clients, covering frontend, backend, and deployment.

## Projects

### Frontend & full-stack

- [Narrative Guard](https://narrative-guard.vercel.app/) ([source](https://github.com/PratikDev/narrative-guard)) — Workspace-based brand governance SaaS platform with multi-tenant isolation, role-based access, and an end-to-end AI audit flow. Three-tier role model (owner/admin/member) enforced server-side, per-brand RAG namespaces for workspace isolation, invite tokens stored as hashes, scheduled Convex actions for async audit processing. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Convex, Convex Auth, Google Gemini, RAG, shadcn/ui, Vitest, React Testing Library.
- [PGSketch](https://github.com/PratikDev/pgsketch) — Linux desktop app that turns visual Postgres schema edits into reviewed migration SQL: a diagram editor with live change highlighting, risk warnings on destructive changes, a rolled-back dry-run validator, and drift detection when the database changes underneath you. Read-only by design, supports Postgres 14+, and ships as a `.deb`. Tech: Electron, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Zod, Vitest, Playwright, Docker.
- [DocTrac](https://github.com/PratikDev/doctrac) — Secure clinic admin portal to manage doctors and patients, with authentication, search and filtering, pagination, and a live analytics dashboard. Tech: React, TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, Zod, TanStack Query, shadcn/ui, JWT.
- [Roadmap App](https://bitcode-roadmap-app.vercel.app/) ([source](https://github.com/PratikDev/roadmap-app)) — Full-stack app with SSR, authentication, a REST API, upvoting, and commenting. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Vercel.
- [Kar Communication](https://www.karcommunication.com/) — Animated landing page for an IT solutions company with React Query powering dynamic content sections. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Firebase, React Query.
- [HWC Landing Page](https://software.helloworldbd.com/) — Company SSR landing page focused on responsive layout and Lighthouse-optimized performance via the Next.js Metadata API. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Zod.
- [Bombus](https://bombus-no.vercel.app/) — Landing page for a Norwegian company, centered on Framer Motion animation work. Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Zod.

### Backend & systems

- [Result Lookup](https://github.com/PratikDev/result-lookup) — High-throughput exam-result publishing system in Go, simulating Bangladesh's SSC result infrastructure serving 2M results. Pre-serialized JSON into Redis ahead of release time behind a publish-gate flag for atomic release, with cursor-based batch seeding and SCAN-based count verification before the gate flip. ~32k RPS peak with zero errors across a 615,000-request load test (driven with [hey](https://github.com/rakyll/hey)), p99 under 105ms at 1,000 concurrent connections, backed by a PostgreSQL fallback with connection limiting. Two-binary architecture (cmd/api, cmd/precompute), handler tests via miniredis. Tech: Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, pgx/v5, Docker, golang-migrate, slog, miniredis.
- [URL Health Checker](https://github.com/PratikDev/url-health-checker) — Background job queue in Go with separate API and worker services (two-binary architecture: cmd/api, cmd/worker); workers claim jobs concurrency-safely via `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`. Exponential backoff written directly in SQL, atomic with status updates; staleness threshold for stale-job recovery instead of a heartbeat, avoiding a race condition on bounded-duration jobs. Graceful shutdown via `signal.NotifyContext`; integration tests against real PostgreSQL, unit tests via `httptest.NewServer`. Tech: Go, PostgreSQL, pgx/v5, Docker, golang-migrate, slog.
- [URL Shortener API](https://url-shortener-api-xiyp.onrender.com) ([source](https://github.com/PratikDev/url-shortener-api)) — Per-IP token-bucket rate limiter using a mutex-protected generic SafeMap, retry-on-conflict short-code generation instead of pre-checking. Non-root Docker user, multi-stage build, integration tests against real PostgreSQL, schema loaded via `//go:embed`. Deployed on Render with managed PostgreSQL. Tech: Go, PostgreSQL, pgx/v5, Docker, golang-migrate, slog.
- [Spud](https://spud-bot.onrender.com/) ([source](https://github.com/PratikDev/spud)) — AI-powered Discord bot for small-team task coordination: LLM-powered duplicate-task detection and scope-drift detection via GitHub branch comparison (Gemini through the Vercel AI SDK), with vector search cutting LLM token usage by an estimated ~10x. Built as a GitHub App with webhook integration: HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification on every GitHub push, tasks auto-closed on PR merge, and Grafana monitoring. A permission model (team lead vs. server admin) is enforced in application code. Tech: TypeScript, Bun, discord.js, SQLite, GitHub Apps API, GitHub Actions, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK, Grafana, Docker.
- [URL Scraper](https://github.com/PratikDev/url-scrapper) — CLI tool using goroutines and mutex-based deduplication for concurrent URL scraping. Tech: Go. (learning project)
- [The Super Tiny Compiler](https://github.com/pratikdev/the-super-tiny-compiler-go) — Small compiler covering tokenizing, parsing, and AST transformation. Tech: Go. (learning project)
